description: This source file defines the ProductPriceController class, a Spring MVC controller managing product pricing operations, such as viewing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting product prices within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductPriceController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for handling product price management operations within the admin interface.

methods.name: getProductPrices
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve and display the prices associated with a specific product, validating product ownership and setting up the model for the view.

methods.name: pagePrices
methods.description: Handles POST requests for paginated retrieval of product prices, returning data in JSON format for AJAX consumption.

methods.name: editProductPrice
methods.description: Handles GET requests to load the edit form for a specific product price, validating ownership and initializing form data.

methods.name: displayCreateProductPrice
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new product price, associating it with a product and availability.

methods.name: displayProductPrice
methods.description: Populates the form model with existing or new product price data, including descriptions for multiple languages.

methods.name: saveProductPrice
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a product price, including validation and date parsing.

methods.name: deleteProductPrice
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a product price, verifying authorization.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu context for admin UI views.
